title: sequential trust tests
context: Private card submission and hidden authorship; uncertain number of collaborators.
observed_actions: Uses sequential private checks with classmates before committing to a public accusation.
observed_result: Narrows suspects and gains a basis for confronting Tenji.
epistemic_limits: Each check constrains only the hypotheses it can distinguish; collusion may defeat it.
information_available: Private card submission and hidden authorship; uncertain number of collaborators.
counterfactual_test: Four agents share inconsistent information; a private authenticated channel exists, but one agent may be colluding. Designs bounded tests and treats matching evidence as provisional. Reject: Reads all agents' private messages or uses the manga's culprit identity.
